info.name: Twilio SendGrid Provisioning Account Lists API

items.docs: **This endpoint allows you to retrieve all of your recipient lists. If you don't have any lists, an empty array will be returned.**
**This endpoint allows you to create a list for your recipients.**
**This endpoint allows you to delete multiple recipient lists.**
**This endpoint allows you to retrieve a single recipient list.**
**This endpoint allows you to update the name of one of your recipient lists.**

params.name: delete_contacts
params.description: Adds the ability to delete all contacts on the list in addition to deleting the list.

items.docs: **This endpoint allows you to delete a specific recipient list with the given ID.**

info.name: Retrieve all recipients on a List

params.name: list_id
params.description: The id of the list of recipients you want to retrieve.

params.name: page
params.description: Page index of first recipient to return (must be a positive integer)

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of recipients to return at a time (must be a positive integer between 1 and 1000)

items.docs: **This endpoint allows you to retrieve all recipients on the list with the given ID.**

info.name: Add Multiple Recipients to a List

params.name: list_id
params.description: The id of the list of recipients you want to retrieve.

items.docs:
**This endpoint allows you to add multiple recipients to a list.**

Adds existing recipients to a list, passing in the recipient IDs to add. Recipient IDs (base64-encoded email addresses) should be passed exactly as they are returned from recipient endpoints.

info.name: Add a Single Recipient to a List

params.name: list_id
params.description: The ID of the list that you want to add the recipient to.

params.name: recipient_id
params.description: The ID of the recipient you are adding to the list.

items.docs: **This endpoint allows you to add a single recipient to a list.**

info.name: Delete a Single Recipient from a Single List

params.name: list_id
params.description: The ID of the list that you want to add the recipient to.

params.name: recipient_id
params.description: The ID of the recipient you are adding to the list.

items.docs: **This endpoint allows you to delete a single recipient from a list.**

params.name: page_size
params.description: Maximum number of elements to return. Defaults to 100, returns 1000 max

items.docs: **This endpoint returns an array of all of your contact lists.**

**This endpoint creates a new contacts list.**

Once you create a list, you can use the UI to [trigger an automation](https://sendgrid.com/docs/ui/sending-email/getting-started-with-automation/#create-an-automation) every time you add a new contact to the list.

A link to the newly created object is in `_metadata`.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the list on which you want to perform the operation.

params.name: contact_sample
params.description: Setting this parameter to the true  will cause the contact_sample to be returned

items.docs:
**This endpoint returns data about a specific list.**
Setting the optional parameter `contact_sample=true` returns the `contact_sample` in the response body. Up to 50 of the most recent contacts uploaded or attached to a list will be returned.
The full contact count is also returned.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the list on which you want to perform the operation.

items.docs: **This endpoint updates the name of a list.**

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the list on which you want to perform the operation.

params.name: delete_contacts
params.description: Flag indicates that all contacts on the list are also to be deleted.

items.docs:
**This endpoint allows you to deletes a specific list.**

Optionally, you can also delete contacts associated to the list. The query parameter, `delete_contacts=true`, will delete the list and start an asynchronous job to delete associated contacts.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the list on which you want to perform the operation.

params.name: contact_ids
params.description: Comma separated list of contact IDs that you want to remove from the specified contacts list.

items.docs:
**This endpoint allows you to remove contacts from a given list.**

The contacts will not be deleted. Only their list membership will be changed.
**This endpoint returns the number of contacts on a specific list.**
